s1.syndrome_frame: Acute lower abdominal pain with nausea and vomiting in a young female
salient_findings: Cystic mass arising from the right tubo-ovarian complex
key_facts: Negative urine human chorionic gonadotropin test
Second abdominopelvic ultrasound suggestive of retrocecal appendicitis
Purulent fluid noted within the cyst

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute lower abdominal pain with nausea and vomiting in a young female
salient_findings: Cystic mass arising from the right tubo-ovarian complex
key_facts: Negative urine human chorionic gonadotropin test
Second abdominopelvic ultrasound suggestive of retrocecal appendicitis
Purulent fluid noted within the cyst

shortlist.label: Tubo-ovarian abscess
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with right lower-quadrant abdominal pain, tenderness, and a cystic mass with purulent fluid was found during surgery.

shortlist.label: Ovarian cystadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: A 15 × 6 cm cystic mass with regular margins was found arising from the right tubo-ovarian complex.

shortlist.label: Pelvic inflammatory disease
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with lower abdominal pain, tenderness, and a cystic mass with purulent fluid, which could be related to pelvic inflammatory disease.

shortlist.label: Ruptured ovarian cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with sudden onset of abdominal pain and a cystic mass was found during surgery.

shortlist.label: Ovarian neoplasm
shortlist.why_kept: A cystic mass was found during surgery, which could be a neoplastic process.

shortlist.label: Pyosalpinx
shortlist.why_kept: Purulent fluid was noted within the cyst, which could indicate a pyosalpinx.

shortlist.label: Adnexal torsion
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with sudden onset of abdominal pain and a cystic mass was found during surgery, which could be related to adnexal torsion.

shortlist.label: Hydrosalpinx
shortlist.why_kept: A cystic mass was found during surgery, which could be a hydrosalpinx.

raw.rationale: The presence of a cystic mass with purulent fluid and the patient's symptoms of abdominal pain and elevated leukocyte count and C-reactive protein are consistent with a tubo-ovarian abscess.

rejected.label: Ovarian cystadenoma
rejected.why: Ovarian cystadenoma is a type of benign tumor and would not typically present with purulent fluid or signs of infection.

rejected.label: Pelvic inflammatory disease
rejected.why: While PID can cause similar symptoms, the presence of a discrete cystic mass with purulent fluid suggests a more localized process like a tubo-ovarian abscess.

rejected.label: Ruptured ovarian cyst
rejected.why: A ruptured ovarian cyst might cause acute pain and fluid in the pelvis, but it would not typically cause purulent fluid or signs of infection.

rejected.label: Ovarian neoplasm
rejected.why: An ovarian neoplasm might cause a cystic mass, but it would not typically cause purulent fluid or signs of infection.

rejected.label: Pyosalpinx
rejected.why: Pyosalpinx refers to a fallopian tube filled with pus, which might be part of the presentation, but the presence of a cystic mass suggests a tubo-ovarian abscess.

rejected.label: Adnexal torsion
rejected.why: Adnexal torsion would cause severe pain and might cause a mass, but it would not typically cause purulent fluid or signs of infection.

rejected.label: Hydrosalpinx
rejected.why: Hydrosalpinx refers to a fallopian tube filled with fluid, which might be part of the presentation, but it would not typically cause purulent fluid or signs of infection.
